operations.description: Tagged operations applied in order; the whole call succeeds or fails atomically

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer to a state field, e.g. /items_counted

action.description: Must match the field's merge policy; lww fields take lww-set or lww-delete

value.description: JSON text of the payload; strings stay quoted, e.g. "\"scan\"". lww-set: full replacement value; lww-delete: null; append/union: array of new items only; sum: integer amount to add, not the new total; max: candidate number; once: the single permanent value
